headline: Palantine Berm Heaviest; Mooring County Held Entire by Wardens
war_summary: Palantine Berm has become the war's sharpest fight since the last edition, ten events in the past two hours and twenty in six about The Pippeli Stones, with the ground now reading four Colonial works, two Warden and one unclaimed, where the earlier report found a three-three split. Losses there run near six hundred Colonial and better than eight hundred Warden an hour, both rising. Mooring County, twelve works Warden and none Colonial, has gone quiet in the past two hours after thirty-six events in the day. Weathered Expanse still carries the heaviest traffic of the past twenty-four hours, sixty-three events, though nothing has been reported there since late evening; it stands seven Warden works, none Colonial and two unclaimed. Nevish Line counts three events at Grief Mother, casualties above a thousand an hour on each side. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua logged twenty events, the most of any single base. Linn Mercy remains the costliest ground, some eighteen hundred Warden and twelve hundred Colonial casualties an hour, with Outwich Ranch changing hands. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle show lighter activity. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
